question: The government of india launched a new programme called the New India Literacy Programme (NILP) for five years, from FY's ___________ to ____________ with a budget of Rs. 1,037.90 crores.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2022-23 to 2026-27.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **New India Literacy Programme **(NILP) will run from **FY 2022-23 to 2026-27** with a budget of Rs. **1,037.90 crores.**
 
• The NILP aims to provide functiona**l literacy and numeracy **to over** 60 million non-literate **and low-literate adults in the age group of **15-45 years**.
 
• The programme will focus on **digital and vocational literacy, **and will use technology-enabled learning platforms to reach out to learners in remote and difficult-to-reach areas.
 
• The programme will also involve **community participation and engagement** and will be implemented through a **decentralized and participatory approach.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The ability to **read, write, speak, and listen** in a way that facilitates efficient communication and helps us make sense of the outside world is known as **literacy.**
 
• In India,** 77.70%** of people are **literate **overall (2021 and 2022).
 
• And it takes a very long time to achieve this weightage through **policies and reforms.**
 
• When India gained its independence in 1947, the country's literacy rate was extremely** low.**
 
• Merely **18%** of the total populace possessed literacy skills.
